units: Targ. O. Lev. VIII, 31 פַּקְדִּית Mss. (oth. ed. Ithpa.; ed. Berl. Pa., v. infra).

senses.gloss: [to give in charge,] to store up.—Part. pass. פָּקִיד; pl. פְּקִידי.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 33b:5">Pes. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>משקין מיפקד פקידי</he> (Rashi: <he>מִיפְּקִיד</he>) liquids (in grapes) are stored up (the shell being merely a vessel), opp. <he>מיבלע בליעי</he>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 7:5">Targ. Gen. VII, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 7:9">9</cite> (ed. Berl. <he>פַּק׳</he>, without Dagesh). Ib. XLIX, 33.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 68:29">Targ. Ps. LXVIII, 29</cite>.

Targ. Am. IX, 3, sq. (ed. Wil. אַפְקִיד Af.); a. v. fr.—Pesik. Baḥod., p. 155ᵇ רבי … הוה מְפַקֵּד לחבריה וכ׳ R. Z. commanded the students (saying), go and hear R. L. preach; Y. R. Hash. IV, beg. 59ᵇ. Y. Ber. IV, 7ᶜ bot.; ib. דרבי מיפקד (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 3:2:2">Koh. R. to III, 2</cite> <he>הוה מפקד גו ביתיה</he> gave orders in his house (made his will); a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְפַקַּד</he>, v. infra.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 36a:11">B. Mets. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>הוו מַפְקְדֵי מרייהו וכ׳</he> used to leave their hoes in charge of a certain old woman; <he>יומא חד אפקדינהו וכ׳</he> one day they left them with &c.; a. fr.
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 8:31">Targ. O. Lev. VIII, 31</cite>, v. supra.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 34:34">Targ. Ex. XXXIV, 34</cite>; a. fr.—
Ab. Zar. 14ᵃ; 21ᵃ מִיפְקְדִינָן Rashi (ed. מְפַקְּדִינָן, Part. pass. Pa.), v. פָּנִים.

senses.gloss: to be given in charge, be deposited.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 5:23">Targ. Lev. V, 23</cite> (O. ed. Lsb. <cite ref="Q01450"><he>אִתַּפְקַד</he></cite>).—
